D: Harry returns to Hogwarts for the final battle against Voldemort.
P: Serve the mains when Aberforth feeds the trio at the Hog's Head.
S: Parmesan crisps spooned into rounds on baking paper, baked at 190C for 6 minutes until golden as coins, served with fig jam.
escaping Gringotts on the back of the dragon
Chicken wings baked at 220C for 45 minutes, tossed in a fiery glaze of chilli, honey and soy, scattered with sesame.
Hogsmeade sausage rolls with brown sauce
sneaking back into Hogsmeade at night

Pork mince with onion and sage rolled in puff pastry, egg washed and baked at 200C for 25 minutes, with brown sauce. Mix 500g pork mince with 1 grated onion, 1 tbsp chopped sage, 1 tsp fennel seeds, 40g breadcrumbs and plenty of salt and pepper. Halve 2 sheets puff pastry, lay a log of filling along each strip, roll up and seal with beaten egg. Cut each log into 4, brush with egg and scatter with sesame seeds. Bake at 200C for 25 minutes until puffed and golden. Serve warm with brown sauce.
M: Aberforth feeding Harry, Ron and Hermione at the Hog's Head
Lamb shoulder braised with onions, carrots and stout for 3 hours, served with mash and crusty bread.
everyone gathered in the Great Hall after the battle

Roast chicken with lemon and thyme, roast potatoes, peas and gravy, laid out for everyone who stayed to fight. Rub a 1.8kg chicken with 40g butter, salt and thyme and stuff with a halved lemon and garlic. Roast at 200C for 75 minutes. Parboil 1kg potatoes in chunks for 8 minutes, shake to rough the edges and roast in hot oil for 50 minutes. Rest the chicken 10 minutes, then stir 1 tbsp flour into the pan juices and whisk in 300ml chicken stock to make gravy. Serve with buttered peas, laid out on big platters.

nineteen years later at King's Cross
Shortcrust filled with warmed golden syrup, breadcrumbs and lemon zest, baked at 180C for 30 minutes, served with cream.
K: the end of the Battle of Hogwarts
Roasted pumpkin blended with apple juice, honey and cinnamon, strained and served chilled.

s.how: Mix 150g grated parmesan with chopped thyme. Spoon small rounds onto a lined tray and flatten into coins. Bake at 190C for 6 minutes until golden and lacy. Cool on the tray and pile them up like a vault full of gold with a pot of fig jam.

s.note: escaping Gringotts on the back of the dragon
s.how: Toss 1kg chicken wings with salt and bake at 220C for 45 minutes until crisp. Warm 3 tbsp honey with 2 tbsp soy sauce and 2 chopped red chillies until sticky. Toss the wings through and scatter with sesame seeds. Hot enough to escape a bank on.

m.note: Aberforth feeding Harry, Ron and Hermione at the Hog's Head
m.how: Brown 1kg diced lamb shoulder, then add 2 onions and 3 carrots. Pour in 375ml stout and water to cover and simmer for 3 hours until tender. Serve over buttery mash from 1kg potatoes with crusty bread on the side.

w.n: Platform nine and three-quarters treacle tart
w.note: nineteen years later at King's Cross
w.how: Blind bake a shortcrust case. Warm 400g golden syrup with 100g breadcrumbs and the zest and juice of a lemon and pour into the case. Bake at 180C for 30 minutes until just set. Serve warm with a pour of cream.

d.note: the end of the Battle of Hogwarts
d.how: Roast 300g butternut pumpkin until soft and cool. Blend with 1L apple juice, a spoon of honey and a pinch of cinnamon until smooth. Strain into a jug, chill and pour over ice. Raise a glass to everyone who stayed to fight.
